Implements pma: maps 10-bit component type ids to RoomComponent subclasses, throwing "Unrecognised component type", and fills the 63 component display names.
Interface implemented by RoomComponentFactory to create, read and write RoomComponents; SpriteState installs an instance in vha.field_c.
lba.createMazeGenerator builds it for type 0, which AppletGameShell.field_r labels "Recursive Backtracker"; it carves from an 8192-entry int stack.
lba.createMazeGenerator builds it for type 1, which AppletGameShell.field_r labels "Striped"; it picks one random gap per stripe.
lba.createMazeGenerator builds it for type 2, which AppletGameShell.field_r labels "Prim's Algorithm"; it grows from a frontier deque picked at random.
lba.createMazeGenerator builds it for type 3, which AppletGameShell.field_r labels "Division"; it splits the area with a wall and recurses into four sub-rectangles.
The only Spawner subclass, built by pha.readSpawner for the single valid spawner type.
